contract.sharing_contract: anyone-with-the-link EDIT (Drive permission type=anyone, role=writer) is intentional and must be preserved; never migrate to named-user-only (F02).
contract.idempotency_contract: provisioning_key = company_id::planner_kind; Drive readback on appProperties skill35_provisioning_key before copy; replay returns the existing file with deduped=true (F15). Durable claim/ledger lives in the ONB/CC caller.

input_schema.templateSheetId: string (required, Google Sheet ID of the fleet template)

output_schema.sharedWith: literal(anyone with the link can edit)

credential_references: googleDriveOAuth2Api — select the operator Google Drive credential on: Copy Template Sheet, Set Anyone Can Edit, Drive Readback, Tag Provisioning Key (re-wire after import; never committed).

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', deduped: false, sheetId: $('Tag Provisioning Key').first().json.id, sheetUrl: 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/' + $('Tag Provisioning Key').first().json.id + '/edit', sheetName: $('Tag Provisioning Key').first().json.name, sharedWith: 'anyone with the link can edit', provisioning_key: $('Interpret Readback').first().json.provisioningKey, company_id: $('Validate + Build Provisioning Key').first().json.body.company_id, planner_kind: $('Validate + Build Provisioning Key').first().json.body.planner_kind, schema_version: '1.1.0' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', deduped: true, sheetId: $json.existingFile.id, sheetUrl: 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/' + $json.existingFile.id + '/edit', sheetName: $json.existingFile.name, sharedWith: 'anyone with the link can edit', provisioning_key: $json.provisioningKey, company_id: $('Validate + Build Provisioning Key').first().json.body.company_id, planner_kind: $('Validate + Build Provisioning Key').first().json.body.planner_kind, schema_version: '1.1.0' }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'error', message: 'Failed to create sheet. Check Google Drive credentials and template access.', error: $json.message || 'Unknown error' }) }}
